convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load 'Volume_Weighted_MA_Digit_System' custom indicator with proprietary buffer logic (buffers 6 with values 1-3 for signals). Includes external TradeAlgorithms.mqh for position management. Signal logic depends on opaque custom indicator buffers that cannot be replicated with built-in MT5 indicators.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - seconds per bar of the indicator timeframe
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for trade signal timing

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator calculation
UpSignalTime - timestamp for buy signal validity
DnSignalTime - timestamp for sell signal validity

other_exits: Buy positions closed when custom indicator buffer 6 color value drops below 2 (bearish signal)
Sell positions closed when custom indicator buffer 6 color value rises above 2 (bullish signal)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum determines sizing: LOT=fixed lot of MM value, FREEMARGIN/BALANCE/LOSSFREEMARGIN/LOSSBALANCE=fraction of respective margin measure using MM value as percentage

custom_logic_notes: Signal logic uses custom indicator buffer 6 with 2 values read from SignalBar (default=1, previous bar). Col[1] is the color index: >2=bullish, <2=bearish. Col[0] is an additional filter: for buy, Col[0]<3; for sell, Col[0]>1. When SignalBar=0, signals are evaluated on every tick (intrabar), otherwise only on new bar. The Recount flag forces re-evaluation on first tick. BuyPosOpen/SellPosClose are gated by BuyPosOpen/SellPosClose input booleans. BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen receive UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime (last bar date + one timeframe period) which likely controls trade validity window in TradeAlgorithms.mqh. SL/TP values of 1000/2000 pips are raw integer values passed to TradeAlgorithms.mqh which may internally apply digit adjustment (multiply by 10 for 5-digit brokers). GlobalVariableDel_ in OnDeinit cleans up global variables.
python_conversion_notes: The Volume_Weighted_MA_Digit_System custom indicator must be fully reverse-engineered and reimplemented in Python. Its buffer 6 output (color histogram with integer values 1-3 representing bearish/neutral/bullish states) is the core signal source. TradeAlgorithms.mqh must also be ported - it handles position open/close with margin modes, signal time validity, deviation control, and global variable management. The conditional position sizing (5 MarginMode variants) needs careful mapping. SL/TP of 1000/2000 are in points (not pips) and need digit-aware conversion. The new-bar guard with CIsNewBar class and the IsNewBar/SignalBar==0 dual-path logic must be replicated exactly. The LoadHistory call ensures bar data availability before signal evaluation.
